title: The Sims 2: Bon Voyage
shortDescription: The Sims 2: Bon Voyage helps define a PC (Windows) simulation path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Places a source-linked simulation entry in the PC (Windows) browsing path.
Uses structured metadata as provenance rather than imported review copy.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Recorded for the PC (Windows) simulation discovery path using the frozen Wikidata metadata snapshot; this remains a browsable catalog record, not a score.
